_comment: The narrator voice used for module videos. To change voice, ask Claude to list voices (ElevenLabs connector, creative_list_voices), pick one, and update voice_id, name and model_id here. Keep notes honest about what the connector cannot set.
name: Roger - Laid-Back, Casual, Resonant
notes: Matches the recordings made in the ElevenLabs app (premade, multilingual v2). The app used stability 50, similarity 75, speed 1.0; the connector cannot set those, so the output can differ slightly from an app recording. A test line measured the same loudness and pitch (about 112 Hz). Cloned voices were refused on the user's plan, and a designed voice was refused once with an account-activity message, so prefer premade voices.
